narrationTexts: I'll start by finding remaining `db.query` call sites.
finalText:
**Migrated 36 `db.query` calls across 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** All 78 JS files pass `node --check`. No `db.query` left in `packages/`.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. Its 2 calls still use the old form.

| Area | Files |
|---|---|
| accounts | 3 |
| billing | 2 |
| catalog | 2 |
| orders | 2 |
| support | 2 |
| analytics | 1 |

Next: decide on `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` before the driver drops `query`.
